meta.name: OCF Low-Vol Stable Cash-Flow Basket V5.6b
meta.objective: Test whether operating cash-flow yield plus low-volatility can form a cleaner cross-sector stable cash-flow basket than the prior low PB / FCF narrative.

universe.name: PIT candidate pool from bank, utilities/electricity, highway infrastructure and port/rail infrastructure sleeves
universe.construction: Each sleeve must pass its own PIT universe and data availability gate before entering the V5.6b basket constructor.

data.vendor: JoinQuant/DataJQ PIT panels, reviewed sector evidence where available, and JoinQuant real daily open/close execution prices
data.cash_dividend_policy: real cash dividends from JoinQuant STK_XR_XD, net_cash_per_share after 20% tax, paid on ex-date proxy
data.stock_action_policy: bonus/transfer shares adjust local unadjusted-price holdings on ex-date

excluded_core_factors.name: low_price_to_book
excluded_core_factors.reason: V5.6 common-window ablation and formal IC showed weak or negative evidence at basket level.

excluded_core_factors.name: free_cash_flow_yield
excluded_core_factors.reason: V5.6 evidence showed low coverage and weak incremental impact; keep as future diagnostic rather than core score.

defensive_rule.reason: V5.6b tests signal definition only; it does not add market-timing defense.

individual_stop_loss_take_profit.reason: Fixed exits are not part of the research hypothesis.

validation.acceptance_rule: PM cannot accept the basket from 2021-2026 platform-confirmation returns alone. Promotion requires stable evidence, clean data gates, overfit audit, platform attribution and paper trading.
